SHADOW-OBSERVATION-POLICY.json.semantics: Observed source-composite RGB and component-validated visible-paint displacement; intrinsic blur/opacity remain unknown

FINAL-BACKGROUND-POLICY.json.stage: Final background scalar after earlier heads, before independent primary/outer source observations
FINAL-BACKGROUND-POLICY.json.backgroundIndexSemantics: Original ranker provenance; emitted RGB is post-head
FINAL-BACKGROUND-POLICY.json.warmSemantics: Restore previousRGB and remove own evidence before recomputing
FINAL-BACKGROUND-POLICY.json.sourceSummary: Native exterior X102 plus glyph24 plus directional24; frozen V4 choice followed by separate .95 directional comparator; existing RGB palette only

fillPalettePolicy.rank: newly covered native interior pixels, capped distance reduction, RGB lexical
fillPalettePolicy.candidateUniverse: every distinct actual RGB in every certified native body interior

NATIVE-GRADIENT-CONTOUR-POLICY.json.stage: Final source stage: contour RGB, owned append-only palette, then certified primary, interior palette pruning, and learned native primary; warm native quality is peeled before pruning and certified primary and native palette restoration
NATIVE-GRADIENT-CONTOUR-POLICY.json.indexSemantics: outlineIndex preserves original ranker provenance; RGB is the final source-composite estimate

NATIVE-OUTER-SHELL-POLICY.json.stage: After final source primary RGB observation
NATIVE-OUTER-SHELL-POLICY.json.semantics: Visible native ordered bands only; unobserved directions remain censored. Nominal scalar width and earlier style heads are preserved.

NATIVE-PRIMARY-QUALITY-POLICY.json.paletteContract: [newRGB] + previousColors[1:] EXACT; secondary order/multiplicity unchanged; no old primary append; no dedup
NATIVE-PRIMARY-QUALITY-POLICY.json.stage: END gradient attach, after interior pruning; before outer-shell

segmentation/policy.scope: fixed-localization host segmentation; source RF/pixel observations required
